workstream: P6 / AC1032 TABLESTYLE generated control handle role

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.field: The handle for the TABLESTYLE cell style named Table is a hard owner.

change.detail: The generated AC1032 TABLESTYLE frame helper now encodes the Table cell-style owner as DwgHardOwnership instead of DwgHardPointer. The parser's existing hard-owner requirement was unchanged.
change.priorFailure: Focused data-flag, cell-style-type, and margin-override controls failed at the TABLESTYLE owner-handle check because the generated frame used the wrong role.

limits: This corrects generated test input only; it does not establish new physical-producer or consumer qualification.
